_comment: Curated Family -> Creator (SPDX originator: the lab that TRAINED the weights) dimension. DISTINCT from Provider (the SPDX supplier/distributor). DATA-DRIVEN seed read by loadCreatorTable (parse/data glob); loud-at-codegen via ValidateCreatorTable, graceful-at-runtime via loadCreatorTableSafe (lineage.go / datasources.json precedent). Family -> Creator is a FUNCTION (BCNF): each family appears at most once; an unmapped family is expressed by OMITTING its row (Family.Creator returns CreatorNone), never a row with an empty creator. Every 'family' must satisfy Family.IsKnown. Initial seed = the 9 UAT-confirmed lab mappings 'as listed'; VARIANT families (glm-air, gpt-mini, gemini-flash, qwen3.5, deepseek-flash, mistral-large, ...) are intentionally NOT seeded here and are extended later by the huggingface ingest.
